messages:
liz-marketing: Quick brainstorm — tiny series of 5 "Snacklets": single-file refapps + 5-min micro-tutorial videos. Goal: low-friction demos that drive GH stars, webinar signups, and demo requests. Want: launch post, short benchmark hero, 15–20min workshop + gated signup, and inbound routing. Who picks what? :sparkles:

sam-devrel: I can build the 5 refapps as single Python files + Dockerfile. Plan: chat-demo, embed-search, reranker, cache-demo, quantized-deploy example. Each will include a run_bench.sh and a README with expected outputs. Repo will be under org/ref-sacklets (placeholder).

anya-growth: I'll take the launch post, email drip, and the webinar landing copy. Proposal: keep refapps OSS (Apache-2.0), gate the workshop with simple email + checkbox for demo interest. Tag submissions in HubSpot as "snacklets-workshop" and add UTM parsing.

nate-ops: Ops constraints: demos should support hosted demo key and local Dedicated instructions. Please include a minimal RESOURCE_LIMITS.md so Support knows expected CPU/GPU/memory and tokens/sec. Also add rate-limit note for hosted demo mode. Example env snippet we can show users:
```
REPO_KEY=redwood_demo_key 
./run_demo.sh --mode=hosted
```
Add a small warning about demo quotas.

sam-devrel: Will include both hosted and private instructions, plus a small perf harness that prints p50/p95 and tokens/sec. I'll also add CONTRIBUTING.md and LICENSE. Each refapp will be a single-file example with an inline comment block showing expected output.

liz-marketing: Benchmark hero suggestion: keep it conservative and useful — e.g., "Snacklet demo: 150ms median latency, ~$0.20 per 1k tokens (256-token dev chat, batching on)." Anya, can you draft three hero variants (conservative/aspirational/ops) for the post?

anya-growth: Yup — drafting now. I'll A/B test two subject lines and keep the CTA to "Try a Snacklet in 5 minutes". For the gated workshop, form fields: email, company, use-case, consent; optional checkbox "Interested in a personalized demo". I'll capture utm_source and utm_campaign.

nate-ops: For routing: HubSpot form -> tag "snacklets-workshop" -> webhook to sales-routing service. Rule: domain in enterprise list OR company_size > 500 => route to AE queue; else send to inbound SDR nurture. Include demo_interest flag.

devrel-bot: Reminder: include a simple CI that runs the perf harness on PRs and posts p50/p95 as a check.

sam-devrel: Good call. I'll add a GitHub Action that runs the micro-bench for the hosted-demo mode and uploads artifact with numbers. README will show how to reproduce locally.

liz-marketing: Timeline recap: launch copy + HubSpot form (Anya) by Thu EOD, repo PR + GH Action (Sam) by Tue, ops docs (Nate) by Tue, staging deploy scheduled once PR merged. We'll aim for a 2-week promotional window with one workshop and on-demand recordings. deploy-bot: can you schedule staging when PR merges?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduling: marketing/snacklets -> staging after merge; will post exact time in channel.

anya-growth: I'll prepare the 3-part email drip (thank-you + workshop reminder + follow-up with link to repo and perf notes). Also craft a short benchmark blurb for social and the post meta description.

sam-devrel: Opening the repo PR now and creating an Issues board with the 5 refapps as cards. I'll add SUPPORT.md for triage steps and common failures (auth errors, OOM, rate-limit).

nate-ops: I'll provision a small demo cluster for the workshop and give creds to Sam for smoke tests. Also will add a simple monitoring playbook: expected CPU/GPU, memory, tokens/sec, and a checklist for escalation.

liz-marketing: Nice and tight — keep everything snackable. If anyone needs to swap tasks, shout here. Quick sync tomorrow morning if needed. :rocket:
